column1: # The real org fixture: three public grafana repositories, each pinned at one
# rev, chosen so the corpus carries a TWO-HOP dependency chain rather than three
# unrelated checkouts:
#     alloy ── requires ──> dskit ── requires ──> gomemcache
# SIZES are the GitHub `size` field (full history, MiB), measured before any
# clone. The brief's ceiling is 200 MB each:
#     grafana/alloy                    157.4  kept
#     grafana/dskit                     14.9  kept
#     grafana/gomemcache                 0.2  kept
#     grafana/grafana-plugin-sdk-go      9.3  DROPPED, no repo in the trio
#                                             requires it: zero dep edges
#     grafana/tempo                    207.2  over the ceiling
#     grafana/pyroscope                246.3  over the ceiling
#     grafana/loki                     500.6  over the ceiling; alloy requires
#                                             it, so it lands as corpus_boundary
# REV KIND. `tag` is a released tag. `commit` is the sha the DEPENDING
# repository's own go.mod pins, used where a repository publishes no tags at
# all: `grafana/dskit` has zero tags, and `grafana/gomemcache` is pinned by
# dskit the same way. Pinning the required sha is what makes the dep edge a
# fact about this corpus rather than about whatever HEAD happens to be.
# slug
grafana/alloy
grafana/dskit
grafana/gomemcache
